The *Āsavasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.16) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Like other sections of the *Duka-paṭṭhāna*, it applies the twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the dyad (*duka*) of states associated with defilements or influxes (*āsava-sampayutta*) [SuttaCentral]. No direct discussions of this individual section were retrieved in the examined secondary passages, which instead treat the corresponding dyadic definitions found in the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*.
According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits extensive internal text reuse across the Abhidhamma, sharing 285 matching passages with 54 other Pali texts, predominantly within other divisions of the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. Its closest affinities are with other analyses involving the influx group (*āsavagocchaka*), including *Patthana* 2.3 (53 matches, totaling 10,400 characters), *Patthana* 4.4, *Patthana* 3.4, and closely related dyad variants such as the *Āsavaāsavasampayuttaduka* (*Patthana* 8.18) and the parallel treatment in *Patthana* 14.15 (which shares a near-identical sequence with 0.96 similarity) [DharmaNexus]. It also exhibits high structural reuse with analogous dyadic treatments of fetters (*Saññojanasampayuttaduka*, *Patthana* 8.22) and ties (*Ganthasampayuttaduka*, *Patthana* 8.28) [DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral lists no external parallels, and DharmaNexus records no cross-language alignments with a score of 10 or higher [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
